design.embed: ETKDGv3, 3 attempts (deterministic seed, random coords on retry)
design.metal_construction: bare metal atom + DATIVE bonds to the top-CN donors
design.complete_donor_set: neutral hetero N/P/S/O + halides + anionic hetero + aromatic N + aromatic carbanion
design.legal_donor_set: neutral hetero N/P/S/O + halides + anionic hetero (the subset RDKit sanitises without breaking kekulisation)

verdict_rule: PASS iff organic_embed_success >= 0.95 AND complete_embed_success >= 0.80 AND donor_count_ge_2 >= 0.90
caveats: The corpus stores the complex as DISCONNECTED fragments with the metal omitted; explicit_metal_share measures exactly that.
organic_embed_success is a weak signal: disconnected fragments are placed independently, so their relative geometry is unconstrained.

The gate is scored on the COMPLETE donor set. A construction that drops the Cp / pyridyl donors embeds fine but no longer describes the species in the table; legal_embed_success is reported only to show where the failure comes from.
The binding mode is not in the data. donor_classes() is a heuristic; a Cp ring is counted as one donor and a chelating N,N ligand is not distinguished from two monodentate donors.
A successful embed is not a correct geometry: no force field was minimised and no reference structure was compared against.
